en.badr-shahin: (The same previous series of relaters)… from Sulaiman that Dawoud bin Kuthair ar-Raqqi said: When I was before Abu Abdullah (a), I said to him: Allah may make me your sacrifice.
Regarding the Holy saying of Allah, "I am All-forgiving to him who repented, believed, and did righteous acts then followed the right guidance, [20:82]"
what is that right guidance, which comes after repentance, faith, and the righteous acts?
He (a) said: (This right guidance is) the acknowledgement of the Imams-one after the other.
